subject: general
question: Rajan is younger than his father by 20 yrs. 5 yr ago his father was 3 times elder than him. Find the present age of his father.
solution:
Let;

Age of Rajan's father = p years

So, Age of Rajan = (p - 20) years

**5 years ago;**

Age of Rajan's father = (p - 5) years

Age of Rajan = (p - 25) years

**According to question;**

Age of father 5 years ago = 3 × Age of Rajan 5 years ago

(p - 5) = 3 × (p - 25)

p - 5 = 3p - 75

2p = 70

p = 35 years

So, Present age of Rajan's father = 35 years

Hence, **"35 yr" **is the correct answer.
